content_html: On Friday, we became aware of what we believe to be an active and narrow-banded exploitation of a vendor in Warp's infrastructure. We detected the operation within hours and were able to remediate and mitigate the impact. We have been in touch with the vendor about the vulnerability. Everyone who uses Warp places a lot of trust in us and that’s not something we take lightly. I’m very sorry that this incident has occurred. The attack appears to have come from an agent swarm using a very sophisticated penetration and escalation technique, likely starting with a hole in a vendor dependency, and ultimately accessing a limited amount of agent trace and telemetry data. We have been working over the weekend and we have notified anyone who we have positively identified as impacted. As of today, we believe an upper bound of roughly 1% of Warp users may have been impacted. We are working closely with the team at Crowdstrike to do a more extensive and comprehensive investigation and have engaged law enforcement. Anyone who has been impacted will receive instructions from us on action they need to take. We will continue to post updates as we learn more.
